Subject: Decision path & legal onramp for Medexa pilot

Hi Ava — thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and a proposed legal/operational onramp so we can get the pilot started without surprises.

Discovery highlights (from today's call):
- Primary economic buyer: you (Ava) + CTO (Lena Moreno) as approver.
- Security point-of-contact: Chris Patel (cc'd contact we captured).
- Procurement: Alan Ruiz (procurement@medexa.com) handles PO/MSA execution.
- Pilot scope: 2-week evaluation, up to 10k inference tokens/day, no PHI.

Recommended contract sequencing (we can adjust):
1) NDA (mutual) — sign first via DocuSign so we can exchange detailed logs and run access tests. Target: 48 business hours.
2) DPA discussion — security team reviews our DPA/DPA controls in parallel with the MSA redline.
3) MSA (pilot statement of work attached as schedule) — we propose an abbreviated pilot SOW + short-term commercial terms; aim for 5-business-day review window.

Questions / asks for you:
- Confirm who will sign NDA (name + title + email) and who owns procurement (Alan?).
- Confirm whether Medexa requires a specific MSA template or if your legal team prefers to redline ours.
- Any compliance docs (SOC2, pen test report) we should attach up front for Chris?

I'll attach a mutual NDA stub and our MSA template to speed review. If you confirm owners, Ben will kick off DocuSign and Monica will drop in the security artifacts.

Next actions (proposed):
- Ava: confirm signers for NDA and procurement contact (today).
- Ben: send DocuSign NDA (upon confirmation).
- Chris: we will send a short DPA checklist + SOC2 link for review.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 15-min call if it helps.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com]

Folks — looping in our legal/ops play to make this concrete. Proposed sequencing and commitments from Redwood: 

1) NDA (DocuSign) — I'll drop the envelope targeted at Lena today. Expect return in 48 hours if routing is straightforward.
2) Security package — Monica, please find SOC2 link and a 1-page DPA checklist attached. Chris: the pilot will generate standard request/response logs (no payload dumps). We'll provide access logs, token usage, and auth audit logs (SSO events). If you need retention shorter than our default 90 days, flag it and we'll scope.
3) MSA & SOW — attach our MSA template and a pilot SOW. For pilots we typically accept a 5-business-day redline window; if Medexa needs 7, we can accommodate but would like procurement's quick path confirmed.

Operational handoff: Monica will own the security artifact delivery and can schedule a 30-min call with Chris tomorrow to walk the DPA checklist. Jordan will own commercial follow-through with Alan.

Docs attached: 
- Redwood_MSA_Template_v1.pdf (MSA + pilot SOW sample)
